Today, special guest Matthew Hazen, the founder of Human Consciousness Support, who dives deep into the complicated relationship between corporations, governments, and global health issues. Hazen discusses an innovative product designed to address the consumption of microplastics and heavy metals, showing results from extensive, groundbreaking research.

This enlightening episode focuses on Masterpeace, a natural detoxifying substance made from volcanic zeolite. The discussion delves into the unknown levels of toxins in our everyday environment and how they adversely affect our health and wellbeing, especially neurological functions and chronic diseases like Alzheimer's. With testimonials and research, the hosts and guest underscore the importance of detoxification and natural remedies to optimize health and happiness in an increasingly toxic world.
